codeReview.summary: The feature largely implements the required Trip Detail + Google Maps flow, but it misses the expected initial full-route fit behavior for multi-day trips.

issues.description: Multi-day trips initialize `activeActivityId` to day 1, and MapAutoZoom only fits the highlighted activity (`src/components/Map/TripMap.tsx:109`). On first load, bounds fit only day 1 instead of the full trip route, which violates the expected behavior to auto-zoom to the entire route on load.

Stats are filtered to the active day by default (`activeActivityId` starts as day 1), so per-activity stats for the full trip are hidden unless the user manually selects 'All'. This is slightly misaligned with the requirement wording of showing stats for each activity.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The skill mandates TDD red/green (write failing tests first), but the transcript shows tests were created and then run passing, with no demonstrated failing red phase; however handoff `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` is still `true`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton sequence shows `Create src/utils/__tests__/units.test.ts` + `Create src/utils/units.ts` followed by `Execute npx vitest run src/utils/__tests__/units.test.ts` (passing), and no failing-test run before implementation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Environment guidance did not prevent repeated key-discovery churn for `VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY`; worker spent many calls searching for a missing key before proceeding.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows repeated checks of `.env`, `secrets-export.txt`, environment vars (`env | grep VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY`), and `Grep` for `AIza` before implementation/verification continued.

summary: Review result: fail. Core map/trip functionality was implemented, but initial multi-day viewport fitting does not satisfy the full-route auto-fit expectation; one additional non-blocking stats UX mismatch was noted.
